svg.title: Living hinge coupon sweep - straight - bridge 1 to 2.5mm
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1 mm. Six 40x120mm straight-pattern coupons, pitch 3, margin 6, 3 segments, 36 rows each. Bridge left to right: 1, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2, 2.5 mm. Cut the #cuts group; the #labels group is engrave-only -- set it to raster/engrave or delete it. Nominal bridge is a centreline value: subtract one kerf for the ligament you actually get.
